summary: The metrics implementation matches the saved plan: _count_monitor_completions uses one aggregate session.execute/select, preserves the three counter semantics, coerces null aggregates to zero, and the focused monitor tests plus ruff, mypy, the required unit gate, and the 99% coverage gate pass. The recovery-grace validation gap was closed by updating the two rebase-path tests to seed a target-advanced stale candidate with fresh same-attempt validation, matching the attempt-scoped merge gate introduced by PR #95.
